methods.m2: reviewer_b linear mean + residual GP + sigma conformal

reuse.active_arm: round3 active arm A (110, sweep_active.csv) as fixed comparator

random_arms.mapping: load=.30+.70u0; dead_time=.5*floor(7u1); bw=50*8**u2 kHz; aperture=30u3 us

mixed_arm.pool: round3 pool.json (5000), excluding only points already picked by M
mixed_arm.refit: before each batch refit M2 (linear lstsq + residual GP incl. hyperparameter optimisation) on S0 + completed M points
mixed_arm.believer: fixed kernel and y-normalisation within batch; pseudo-observation at posterior mean (covariance-only update)
mixed_arm.score: sigma(x) / sqrt(1 + a_c(x)); sigma = residual-GP predictive std incl. WhiteKernel; a_c = number of points already acquired by M (earlier batches + earlier picks in current batch) in the same dead_time category (7 categories)

criteria.A1: active corner mean Winkler < each of 5 random arms (strict); false pass <= 0.5**5
criteria.A2: active corner covered >= each random arm, and active - mean(random) >= 4
criteria.A3: paired one-sided Wilcoxon on 40 corner points, active W_i vs mean over 5 random arms, H1 active lower, p<0.05
criteria.M1: mixed arm passes C1, C2-corner, C2-dt3 (round-3 thresholds incl. width)
criteria.M2: mixed corner covered >= 36 and mixed corner mean Winkler < each of 5 random arms (strict)

hypotheses: H-A and H-M separately; no combined verdict; R report-only; A previously observed
